<?php

class SerializationContext {
    private array $objectRegistry = [];
    private array $referenceMap = [];
    private int $depth = 0;
    private bool $locked = false;
    private array $pendingCallbacks = [];
    private static ?self $activeContext = null;

    public function __construct(private readonly int $maxDepth = 64) {}

    public static function getActive(): ?self {
        return self::$activeContext;
    }

    public function beginSerialization(): void {
        self::$activeContext = $this;
        $this->locked = false;
    }

    public function endSerialization(): void {
        $this->processPendingCallbacks();
        self::$activeContext = null;
    }

    public function registerObject(object $obj, string $serialized): void {
        $id = spl_object_id($obj);
        $this->objectRegistry[$id] = $serialized;
        $this->referenceMap[$id] = $obj;
    }

    public function hasObject(object $obj): bool {
        return isset($this->objectRegistry[spl_object_id($obj)]);
    }

    public function getSerializedObject(object $obj): ?string {
        return $this->objectRegistry[spl_object_id($obj)] ?? null;
    }

    public function incrementDepth(): void {
        $this->depth++;
        if ($this->depth > $this->maxDepth) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Max serialization depth exceeded');
        }
    }

    public function decrementDepth(): void {
        $this->depth--;
    }

    public function acquireLock(): bool {
        if ($this->locked) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->locked = true;
        return true;
    }

    public function releaseLock(): void {
        $this->locked = false;
    }

    public function addPendingCallback(callable $cb): void {
        $this->pendingCallbacks[] = $cb;
    }

    public function processPendingCallbacks(): void {
        while (!empty($this->pendingCallbacks)) {
            $cb = array_shift($this->pendingCallbacks);
            $cb($this);
        }
    }
}

interface AsyncSerializable {
    public function asyncSerialize(SerializationContext $ctx): string;
}

class ObjectSerializer {
    private array $typeHandlers = [];

    public function registerHandler(string $class, callable $handler): void {
        $this->typeHandlers[$class] = $handler;
    }

    public function serialize(object $obj, SerializationContext $ctx): string {
        $ctx->incrementDepth();

        try {
            if ($ctx->hasObject($obj)) {
                return $ctx->getSerializedObject($obj);
            }

            $className = get_class($obj);

            if ($obj instanceof AsyncSerializable) {
                return $this->handleAsyncSerializable($obj, $ctx);
            }

            if (isset($this->typeHandlers[$className])) {
                $handler = $this->typeHandlers[$className];
                $result = $handler($obj, $ctx, $this);
                $ctx->registerObject($obj, $result);
                return $result;
            }

            return $this->defaultSerialize($obj, $ctx);
        } finally {
            $ctx->decrementDepth();
        }
    }

    private function handleAsyncSerializable(AsyncSerializable $obj, SerializationContext $ctx): string {
        // Release lock before async operation to allow concurrent serialization
        $hadLock = false;
        if ($ctx->acquireLock()) {
            $hadLock = true;
        }

        // Temporarily release lock for async operation
        $ctx->releaseLock();

        $result = $obj->asyncSerialize($ctx);

        // Re-acquire if we had it
        if ($hadLock) {
            $ctx->acquireLock();
        }

        $ctx->registerObject($obj, $result);
        return $result;
    }

    private function defaultSerialize(object $obj, SerializationContext $ctx): string {
        $reflection = new \ReflectionClass($obj);
        $properties = $reflection->getProperties();
        $data = ['__class' => get_class($obj), '__props' => []];

        foreach ($properties as $prop) {
            $prop->setAccessible(true);
            $value = $prop->getValue($obj);

            if (is_object($value)) {
                $data['__props'][$prop->getName()] = $this->serialize($value, $ctx);
            } else {
                $data['__props'][$prop->getName()] = $value;
            }
        }

        $serialized = json_encode($data);
        $ctx->registerObject($obj, $serialized);
        return $serialized;
    }
}

class CachedEntity implements AsyncSerializable {
    private static array $serializationCache = [];
    private string $id;
    private mixed $data;
    private ?object $nested;

    public function __construct(string $id, mixed $data, ?object $nested = null) {
        $this->id = $id;
        $this->data = $data;
        $this->nested = $nested;
    }

    public function asyncSerialize(SerializationContext $ctx): string {
        $cacheKey = $this->id . '_' . spl_object_id($this);

        if (isset(self::$serializationCache[$cacheKey])) {
            return self::$serializationCache[$cacheKey];
        }

        // Simulate async: schedule nested serialization as callback
        if ($this->nested !== null) {
            $nested = $this->nested;
            $serializer = new ObjectSerializer();
            $ctx->addPendingCallback(function(SerializationContext $innerCtx) use ($nested, $serializer, $cacheKey) {
                // This callback re-enters the serialization context
                // The lock was released in handleAsyncSerializable
                $nestedResult = $serializer->serialize($nested, $innerCtx);
                self::$serializationCache[$cacheKey . '_nested'] = $nestedResult;
            });
        }

        $result = json_encode(['id' => $this->id, 'data' => $this->data]);
        self::$serializationCache[$cacheKey] = $result;
        return $result;
    }
}

function serializeObjectGraph(object $root): string {

    $serializer = new ObjectSerializer();

    $ctx->beginSerialization();
